m: dīna mfn. (fr. √ dī?) scarce, scanty, RV.
dīna n. distress, wretchedness, Hariv.; Pañc.
a: dīna a. [dī-kta taspa na] 1 Poor, indigent. 2 Distressed, ruined, afflicted, miserable, wretched. 3 Sorry, dejected, melancholy, sad; sā virahe tava dīnā Gīt. 4. 4 Timid, frightened. 5 Mean, piteous; Bh. 2. 51. — naḥ A poor person, one in distress or misery; dīnānāṃ kalpavṛkṣaḥ Mk. 1. 48; dināni dīnoddharaṇocitasya R. 2. 25. — naṃ Distress, wretchedness. — nā The female of a mouse or shrew. Comp. — dayālu, -vatsala a. kind to the poor. — baṃdhuḥ a friend of the poor. — locanaḥ a cat.
